title: Change part of a resource
summary: REST API Development: Change part of a resource. Write a patch for the title.
introduction: PATCH can send only changes. This example uses JSON Merge Patch to change the page count.
learningObjectives: Change part of a resource with REST API Development
Write a patch for the title

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Change part of a resource
blocks.code:
PATCH /books/1 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test
Content-Type: application/merge-patch+json

{"pages":30}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":1,"title":"Moon Trip","pages":30}

blocks.text: The merge-patch document contains only pages. Its rule updates that field while leaving the title intact.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: Only the page count is changed to 30.

blocks.text: Write a patch for the title.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: PATCH formats have different rules; name the media type you support.
